notes.title: THE BIGEEEEST UPDATE (28.11.2023)
notes.content:
The first big update is coming!

Changes:

[list]
[*]Added crosshair. Now you will be able to interact more accurately with objects.
[*]Added a small hint at the corridor loop level.
[*]Added a new segment at the corridor loop level (You really have to try it).
[*]Added an alternate ending, but you'll have to look hard for it. Of course, a *rare* achievement has been added along with the new ending.
[*]Fixed issues about AI.
[/list]

By the way, is there anyone among you who could help with translating the game into Chinese and Japanese? Write in Discord if you are ready to help.
